findings.message: Add a deployment workflow for the new Kafka topics. The new topic manifest is not referenced by any deployment workflow. Existing topic workflows deploy explicitly named manifests, and the application workflow excludes `nais/topics/*`, so merging this change will not provision these topics or their ACLs. The newly enabled streams will consequently be unable to consume their source topics in deployed environments. Add a workflow invoking `reusable-topic-workflow.yml` for this manifest.
